description_en: Counts the number of gateway security key tickets submitted by the current user account. You can specify ticket statuses to filter the count
description_zh: 统计当前用户账号已提交的网关安全密钥工单的数量，可指定统计特定状态的工单
name: CountGatewayTupleOrders

parameters.help_en:
The list of ticket statuses used to filter the count. If you do not specify this parameter, tickets in all statuses are counted.

For valid ticket status values, see the request parameter description
parameters.help_zh:
工单状态过滤列表。若不使用此参数，则表示统计所有状态的工单。

参考工单状态取值
parameters.name: states
